title: Deterministic supplied-P BSGS with charged routing and dense-reference arithmetic

claims.statement: For every valid full-production fixed-G1 inversion instance, the deterministic algorithm in proof.md returns Q in G2 with pairing(Q,P)=z for the exact supplied P. Success probability is 1. Total classical work is at most 2^144 target-group-operation equivalents under C=20000, including all per-target preprocessing, large-storage routing, sorting, lookup, arithmetic, setup and verification. Peak storage is at most 2^145 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^144 equivalents included in total, nonuniform advice zero bytes. This is an analytic banked-storage computation, not a practical attack on this VM; its explicit finite communication model is a material assumption described in proof.md.
